It's been a while since I've been here, but I regularly patrol on my steed.
Well, I go wherever the wind takes me, east or west.

So anyway,
I heard there's some hotshot tearing up these parts lately.
You wouldn't happen to know anything about that... Would you?

Heh, not one for beating around the bush, are ya?
Too many eyes here, we'd just cause trouble.
Wanna take this outside?

Hey, we meet again.
Last time wasn't bad.
But my steed was a notch above.

So, have you improved?
Well, you came to test that, right?
I'll accept the challenge.

It's you.
I never thought my steed would be outdone by you.

But a match is a matter of timing...
What if we go at it again?
How about it? Ready to overtake?
I'll show you that the silver star isn't just for show.
Yes, life is precious.

Phew, I guess I lose sometimes too.
You seem promising.
Let's go at it again if we get another chance.

Oh, by the way, you should wait a bit longer before hitting the accelerator.
Adios.

Phew, at this point,
I have to acknowledge your skill.

I've been to many places, and there are always strong ones out there.
And you're one of them.
Adios.

A match is a matter of timing.
Don't worry too much about it.

If we meet again, give me a shout.
Adios.

This time, I won.
But you have won before...
So, we seem to be well-matched.

Let's go at it again someday, rival.
Adios.

Is it true that 【CRIMSON BOY】 lost?
I can't believe it.

Yeah, it's true.
Not just him, but also his two brothers... 【GOLDEN HANNYA】 and 【IRON OLD MAN】 lost too.
All to one guy named 【{bad_name}】.
What? So, all three of the Kurosaki brothers lost?

Yeah... but the Kurosaki brothers are famous on the Shuto Expressway.
They won't stay silent about this.
Rumor has it they're burning for revenge against 【{bad_name}】.

I really like 【CRIMSON BOY】, who's a model in magazines.
He's a handsome guy.
So, are his brothers and 【{bad_name}】 also handsome?

Whether they're handsome or not...
【GOLDEN HANNYA】 is a hot-headed guy, and his machine is power-tuned.
【IRON OLD MAN】 is a thoughtful type, skilled at blocking techniques.

I haven't seen 【{bad_name}】 directly, so I don't know.
But I've heard... he's rumored to be just an ordinary young man.

Hmm...
Then I'll still support 【CRIMSON BOY】.
He's handsome, after all!

Oh, come on...
I... I'll support 【{bad_name}】.
Handsome guys are my enemies.

【SANDSTORM EMPEROR】?
He's quite a veteran... you don't know him?

He used to be in a duo,
and he's the only one in 《Phantom9》 recognized by 【SNAKE EYES】.

He doesn't just want a victory; he likes to let his opponent go ahead and then overtake them
dramatically.
If you want to exploit a weakness, that's it.

Even though he doesn't look bad, 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】 calls him "creepy."
It's probably because he's obsessed with his own satisfaction.

Hey, so we all know 【SNAKE EYES】 is the top dog of 《Phantom9》...
But who do you think is number two?

Who knows...
【CRAZY MONKEY】 claims to be 《Phantom9》's sub-leader, but...

Honestly, he's pretty underwhelming.
Well, if he has any redeeming qualities...
I guess he plays the clown to lighten the mood.

Lighten the mood? Really?
His stupid wisecracks always set off 【GOLDEN HANNYA】,
and they end up arguing most of the time.

Seriously, it makes me so mad!
Men always extend their noses just because a girl looks a little cute.

Yeah, I'm talking about 【DIRTY FOX】!
She knows it and acts all "pure and innocent."
It's so calculating.

My boyfriend battled her, and she damaged his car with her aggressive driving.
But she got out of her car, bowed her head a bit, and he forgave her because she looked cute.
It's so stupid!

I heard 【STEEL HEART】 came back to the Shuto Expressway a while ago...
He'd been running the mountain passes with his apprentice 【LUCIFER OTSUKA】 these past few years.
Word is he's also reunited with his other apprentice, 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】, who left 《Be Legend》.

Those three were all members of the old "THIRTEEN DEVILS,"
but they share a special bond even among that group.
It's not uncommon to find master-apprentice relationships like that in the street racing world.

Oh man, I came all the way to Tokyo,
and didn't expect to meet another street racer from Fukuoka...

He's called 【RISING SEAMAN】,
and he's an admirable Kyushu man, which is hard to find nowadays.

His machine is focused on aerodynamics tuning.
I ran with him a bit, and his driving was stable and solid.
He's a tough opponent.

But that's beside the point... this is bad.
I don't want anyone to make fun of my name, 【GENKAI SEA LIMITS】.
I managed to avoid saying it and left without giving my name...
Why are there so many pickup artists among the racers?!

【LEMON FLAVOR】 from 《Neo Limited》 and
【MASTER POSITION】 the wanderer are particularly annoying ones to watch out for...
But this guy called 【TORNADO OF LOVE】 is definitely going on my blacklist too!

I came here to race.
Getting hit on with lines like, "Hey miss, haven't we met before?"
and having contact info shoved at me is just plain annoying.

That said, his driving skills were legit. He's quite the formidable opponent.
His gas pedal work was flawless, natural as breathing, light and effortless...
His cornering sense in particular was exceptional.

Lately, there's a woman snooping around our team, 《ROYAL DREAMS》.
They call her 【RUMORED WRITER】, and she's a skilled street racer.
She says she's a web writer running the Shuto Expressway for research...

That sharp gaze, those flawless movements... she's definitely not ordinary.
She won't even let anyone touch her machine.
Who knows what kind of "seven tools" she's equipped with...

...But why did she target our team?
I don't think we're doing anything suspicious, and we blend well into the Shuto Expressway.

Huh? We look suspicious?
Hmm, I guess that's a cultural difference.

I heard 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 left 《Be Legend》.
Apparently his master coming back to the Shuto Expressway lit a fire under him,
and their leader 【SONIC NAPOLEON】 gave his blessing to go.

Looking back now, it's kinda weird how well he fit in—
an ex-THIRTEEN DEVILS member in a team full of former ZODIAC members.

He's going by 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 instead of his THIRTEEN DEVILS name, 【SHITAR KANEYAMA】.
Maybe that shows he's not hung up on the past.
I don't really get it, but you can feel his determination.

Have you ever seen 【LUCIFER OTSUKA】's machine?
I had the chance to talk with him recently and even got to drive alongside him for a bit...
The VTEC sound his S2000 produces is absolutely magnificent!

The moment the battle began and the road opened up...
he slammed the accelerator "con tutta la forza"!
The acceleration was simply overwhelming. I desperately tried to keep up.

As the engine RPMs climbed,
I could feel his fighting spirit "crescendo molto."

And then finally—that glorious VTEC sound
rang out "con passione,"
shaking my eardrums "tempestoso"!

By that time, his S2000 had already completely vanished from my sight!
*pant* *pant* *pant*... Excuse me.
I got a bit too excited there.

Anyway, his strength lies in that overwhelming VTEC sound...
No, wait...it's the acceleration in the high RPM range.
When you hear that engine note change, be careful not to get left behind!

Have you seen a flashy WRX tearing through C1 at insane speeds?
Yeah, the one with all sorts of...peculiar things stuck on it...
Apparently it's highly praised by those who like that sort of thing.
...Anyway, that guy is feared as the 【CRIMSON DEVIL】.

People often notice the flashy exterior,
but his heavily tuned machine has overwhelming acceleration.

Of course, his driving skills are also top-notch,
in battles, he deliberately lets his opponent go ahead.
That's quite confident, isn't it?

He sticks to the tail, gradually applying pressure.
That's why he's called the "Devil."
Then he overtakes in a flash when he sees the opportunity!
So when you fight him, don't give in to the pressure.

【NAMAHAGE】, huh.
He's like the boss of the Shuto Expressway... a real old-timer.

They say he was 【SWIFT EMPEROR】's mentor.
You can imagine how long 【NAMAHAGE】 has been racing.

Later, he joined 《Phantom9》 under 【SNAKE EYES】, had his ups and downs,
but now, he doesn't seem that hungry anymore.

He's old enough now, he's settled down.
He's probably watching the trends of the Shuto Expressway in semi-retirement.

You know 【SHADOW EYES】, the former member of THIRTEEN DEVILS and one of the Big Four?
She once went to the mountain passes.

...With 【PURSUING TAILGUNNER】, also one of the Big Four.
And now they're both back on the Shuto Expressway, racing together again.

There must be something between them...
But you never hear any stories about it.
What's really going on, I wonder...

Oh man... I've been having a lot of trouble lately.
I've always been mentally weak.

Speaking of which, there was a famous street racer who was also mentally weak.
...Yeah, it was 【DYING STAR】.

He was once a member of the THIRTEEN DEVILS, even called one of the Big Four,
but he couldn't get over his losses... he even retired for a while.

But now he's back on the Shuto Expressway, racing again...
Maybe changing his machine helped.
Maybe I should consider a fresh start and change my environment too.

The other day, a nosy woman asked me about 【PURSUING TAILGUNNER】.
She wondered if there was something between him and 【SHADOW EYES】, 
both former THIRTEEN DEVILS and Big Four.

A lot of people like those kinds of stories...
It seems their basis is that they both raced in the mountain passes for a while.

Who knows... I'm not really interested in others' personal lives,
but if there were a romance among the Big Four, that would be surprising.
But unfortunately, I can only see them as "rivals," "comrades-in-arms," or "competitors."

Hey, have you battled with 【MONEY DREAM】?
I'm a huge fan of hers.
I want to challenge her to a battle just once.

She's like a model or actress, isn't she?
That's why she's so popular on TV and in magazines.
Even people who aren't into motorsports know her.

And not just that, her record as a pro racer is amazing.
She has swept various competitions worldwide.
It's said her total prize money is in the billions.
Ahhh, it's so dreamy! I admire her so much!
The other day, I was approached by 【STUBBORN STRAIGHT】 at the Hakozaki Parking Area...

He asked, "Isn't this Daikoku Parking Area?"
At first, I thought he was joking, but he was seriously lost.
Seriously? How can he be a street racer with such poor sense of direction...

Well, he has such an unexpected weakness... but he's definitely a skilled street racer.
Until you and 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 showed up,
he was considered one of the top street racers of the new generation.

The long straights of the Bayshore Route are his domain.
Once he gets ahead, no mediocre machine can catch up.

【DREAMING SPIRIT】 is a real pain in the ass.
But, well, I'll give him credit—his skills as a street racer are legit.

There was a time when they used to say, "No one's ever seen him in their rear-view mirror."
Yeah... Meaning nobody could ever get ahead of him.

But here's the thing—if you keep challenging him and losing,
you'll get these anonymous emails that nitpick every little thing you did wrong, giving you "advice."
They mention stuff only someone who was there would know, so it's gotta be 【DREAMING SPIRIT】 himself.

I never gave him my address... Creepy, right?
I bet 【HAPPY CHAPPY】's been selling our personal info on the side...

【SILENT CASSIOPEIA】?
If you're gunning for 【SKULL BULLET】, you'll need to take him down too.

But I'd bet 【SILENT CASSIOPEIA】 already has all your data,
analyzed down to the smallest detail.
The moment you targeted 【SKULL BULLET】, you became a target yourself.

【DEEP BLUE SNIPER】?
I challenged him to a battle once myself.

But it was over in a flash.
I lost before I even knew what hit me.
He lived up to that "sniper" nickname, all right.

You wanna battle 【DAWN GARNET】?
...No matter how strong you are,
winning that beautiful lady's heart ain't gonna be easy.

Heh-heh-heh, that's not your real motive, is it?
But here's the thing—she's the one with love on her mind.
A woman fighting for the man she loves is tough to beat.

【SKULL BULLET】, huh?
He came all the way from America to get revenge on 【SNAKE EYES】,
but how many years has it been now? That's some serious determination.

You might not be interested in this kind of talk, but...
That guy's a big dog in the business world too.
He's been pushing hard into Japan these past few years with aggressive M&A strategies backed by deep pockets.

You've probably noticed the "BIGGINS" name popping up more around the Shuto Expressway.
Like, for instance... Those vending machines over there.

Have you seen 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 lately?
She looks much more like a street racer now!

Rumor has it her GT-R was tuned by "Legendary Tuner".
Even just a glance can tell you it's impressive...
It's completely different from her previous machine!

She's beaten 《CLUB GARUDA》 known for their rough driving,
the Hanshin Expressway powerhouse 《HARISEN Chop》, and the legendary street racers' 《Be Legend》...
And many other skilled street racers have been defeated by her.

How's your racing going?
You want to battle her again, don't you?

Yeah, I thought so.
Rivals are great, aren't they!

Have you heard about the Fairlady Z that runs over 400 km/h?
Sure, you might think there are machines like that out there...

But what if
that Fairlady Z was...an "S30"?

A machine from nearly half a century ago, still running at over 400 km/h...
That's the legend they say.
You'd do well to remember it.
...Oh, it's you.

Have you heard of a racer called 【RECORD:0】?
...If it's even a person.

Almost no one has seen it.
The few witness accounts are strangely vague and unclear.
Appearing like mist, vanishing like mist... It's like some kind of phantom.

I don't know if such a thing really exists.
I've never encountered it myself.

But such rumors persist in whispers.
I thought I should at least let you know.
Hey there, how's it going?
...Have you ever imagined something like this?

Out of nowhere, a machine appears without a sound and flashes you.
The battle begins... You push your pedal to the floor,
but your opponent stays glued to your tail, the distance never changing.

With the exact same movements, following the exact same line.
Yes—like your own shadow.

Eventually, they blow past you in one swift move...
and then vanish, melting into the darkness.
There are rumors of such a machine around here.

They call that machine 【RECORD:01】.
I'd like to meet it myself one day.

You ever heard the name "Xenon"?
Been quiet for the past few years but...
Apparently it used to tear up the American streets back in the day.

Sticks to its prey's rear, locks on target... Then it blasts right through.
The next moment, it's gone without a trace...
Like some kind of ghost.

That "ghost"... It's shown up on the Shuto Expressway too.
Here, they call it 【RECORD:X】.

Heh, interesting.
I'd like to meet it myself, just once.
Me, leader of 《Phantom9》, battling a "ghost"? Now that's a story worth telling.

Yo!
How's it going?

Heh heh heh...
Not long ago, you looked like a total rookie fresh off the streets...
But now you've really grown into a proper street racer.

You beat 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】, didn't you?
If a racer of her caliber acknowledged your skills,
you might just have what it takes to challenge the legendary 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

But that also means...
【SNAKE EYES】, who's hell-bent on revenge against 【SWIFT EMPEROR】,
and his crew 《Phantom9》 have got you squarely in their sights.

The only ones who can match you now are the new generation's top racers.
Especially 【ETERNAL POLARIS】―
Heh heh heh, I wonder what kind of power she's hiding...

A new stage awaits,
with new rivals ready to take you on.
Heh heh heh...
So you're the street racer they call 【{bad_name}】?

I'm 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 of 《Be Legend》.
On my honor as a former member of the THIRTEEN DEVILS,
I challenge you to battle...

Caught off guard by the man in traditional Japanese clothing speaking in Tosa dialect, 
I was still processing when a piercing engine sound cut through the air from the distance.
【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】 seemed drawn to it too, and we both turned our attention to the PA entrance.

What appeared was a jet-black S2000, dark as a demon's cloak.
The figures who stepped out began walking straight toward us.

He had a refined appearance and seemed rather quiet at first glance.
But the primal fighting instinct of a seasoned street racer
radiated an unmistakable air all around him.

I return to the Shuto Expressway after all this time...
And the first thing I find is my old partner.

Y-You're 【Lucifer Otsuka】?!
I-I-I've been wanting to see you sooooo bad!!!

Wait, hold on...
If you're back, that means...!

Yeah, 【STEEL HEART】 is here too.
We wanted to see what these new era racers are made of.
Not just us―other former THIRTEEN DEVILS are gathering as well.

So that's what's happening...
This truly is the dawn of the Shuto Expressway!

If that's how it is, I'm leaving 《Be Legend》!
"The path of racing isn't just one―there are hundreds, thousands, millions."
Our leader's an understanding guy, he'll send me off with his blessing.

That's all well and good, but...
Daigo... You've really changed while I was away...

After the battle, you returned to the parking area with 【UNSHAKABLE RYOMA】
and 【Lucifer Otsuka】. A street racer who watched the battle was waiting there.
The man introduced himself as 【STEEL HEART】.

Taking down both of my disciples... interesting.
When 【TREACHEROUS JACKKNIFE】 told me about you, I had my doubts,
but meeting such a skilled racer makes my return to the Shuto worthwhile.

【SWIFT EMPEROR】, who vanished four years ago, has returned.
Along with the man who trained him...
And almost at the same time, you appeared.

Is this just coincidence?
Or...
Is the demon of the Shuto Expressway calling us together?

【{bad_name}】,
that was one hell of a battle.
You truly are the rising star of this new era.

And here I am, getting carried away reuniting with old friends,
underestimating my opponent... I need more training.
Maybe I should restart my yoga practice and become an ascetic...

I knew you were the type to get obsessed with things...
Before it was the India phase, but now you're all about Ryoma?
...Well, maybe that's the perfect personality for an actor.

Hahaha, a lovely impromptu performance by three who just reunited.
But we'll show you the combination of master and disciples.

This'll make a great story for the others.
【{bad_name}】,
let me test that strength of yours.

After the battle ended and they rested at the parking area, three machines blocked their path.
They didn't know the opponents, but the emblems on their cars were familiar—
they were 《Phantom9》 members.

Both parties exited their machines, sizing each other up.
The three opponents introduced themselves as 【CRAZY MONKEY】, 【DIRTY FOX】,
and 【SANDSTORM EMPEROR】.

So you're the one crushing all the teams around here one by one?
Ain't that exactly what we're doing?

Don't tell me... You're a 《Phantom9》 fan?
Haha, just kidding!

You "Glitter Racer" types
are just out here enjoying your youth, aren't ya?
...But we're different.

Our leader, the second 【SNAKE EYES】, ordered us
to thoroughly crush every street racer on the Shuto Expressway.
Naturally, that includes you.

Well... Personally, I got nothing against you
or the other teams.
Don't take it the wrong way.

Oh, didn't you know?
The current 【SNAKE EYES】 isn't the same guy from four years ago.
The new leader inherited the team and name from the predecessor.

Who cares about all that?
【{bad_name}】's supposed to be strong, right?

Not interested in joining our team?
That'd be way better than crushing you, don't ya think?

Whoa whoa whoa! If we add this guy, we won't be "Nine" anymore!
We'd have to kick someone out!
The most useless member of 《Phantom9》!

Whaaat?
But there's nobody like that except for you, nerd boy!
Though I guess it could be you instead.

Ahaha!
That's harsh, 【DIRTY FOX】!

Well, either way, young master 【SNAKE EYES】
ain't sweet enough to just welcome someone who damaged his rep.

You beat the Kurosaki Brothers
and dragged 《Phantom9》's name through the mud...
We need you to pay for that.

So that's why we're gonna go all out too.
Gotta make the pecking order crystal clear.
We'll be waiting for your challenge.

They parked at the parking area and dozed off in the car without realizing it.
But—
The brief silence was broken by a small knock.

Looking out the window, 【CRIMSON BOY】 was peering into the car.
Behind him, 【GOLDEN HANNYA】 and 【IRON OLD MAN】 stood surrounding the machine.
They wanted them to come out.

Good day...
Or rather, good morning, newcomer.
Did you sleep well?

Hehehe... such an obviously annoyed face.
I'm happy to meet you though.

You've now become the center of attention on the Shuto Expressway.
A far cry from when you nervously crept around
Kandabashi.

The veteran racers who built the Shuto Expressway's history fell one by one,
and even we in 《Phantom9》 tasted bitter defeat.
Among the new generation of racers, you radiate a special presence.

Tch.
Who'd have thought some rookie would grow this fast.
Guess Masamichi wins the bet.

【{bad_name}】!
Thanks to you, I gotta buy Masamichi a strawberry parfait!

However, don't think you've defeated the Kurosaki Brothers just yet.
Our previous battle was merely a test.
This time, we three will challenge you with our true power.

I'm bringing out my special machine just for you.
You'd better appreciate it.

So this is your true strength...
We gave it everything we had,
but we still lost.

Hmph.
Not bad for a rookie, I'll give you that.

Our leader, the second 【SNAKE EYES】...
He's been expecting a racer like you to emerge.
After all... you're the perfect bait to draw out the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Apparently the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】 only cares about new challengers...
To drag him back onto the battlefield,
we need a sacrifice—the hottest racer of the moment.

But damn... with this, 《Phantom9》 is down
to just 【NAMAHAGE】.
Shit, how pathetic...

Hmm... 【{bad_name}】 doesn't seem
to know about 【NAMAHAGE】.

Since he started working as a member of 《Phantom9》,
he's been using several different names.
He's an elusive man.

His former name was 【PURPLE METEOR】,
the legendary Street Racer who ruled the Shuto Expressway before 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

And he's also the 【SWIFT EMPEROR】's mentor.
Yes, a traitor who sided with 【SNAKE EYES】 against his own disciple...
Quite the interesting character, don't you think?

While taking a break at the parking area to check your tires,
a trio of racers approached you.

One was a burly middle-aged man who looked like the very picture of bold and hearty.
Another was his complete opposite—a suave man with refined charm and handsome features.
And the third was a woman with the air of a sophisticated, intellectual career professional.

Oh, if it ain't 【{bad_name}】!
Pleased to make yer acquaintance.
Name's 【RISING SEAMAN】.

These two are 【TORNADO OF LOVE】 and 【RUMORED WRITER】.
It might surprise ya, but I came all the way from Hakata in Kyushu,
so I don't know the Shuto Expressway well—they're showin' me around.

You beat 【ETERNAL POLARIS】, right?
There's always someone better out there.
We battled that kid too—tough opponent.

Did you know?
The whole Shuto Expressway is buzzing about you and 【ETERNAL POLARIS】.

Yeah, about 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】 taking a real liking to 【ETERNAL POLARIS】,
even inviting her to the Shuto Expressway Girls' Club.
And about how you passed out after three corners riding shotgun with 【MELANCHOLIC ANGEL】.

I also heard ya battled those tough guys from 《STRONG FORMATION》,
and not only beat 'em senseless, but made all eleven of 'em
line up and grovel for forgiveness!

I heard you brought a huge griddle to Daikoku Parking Area
and had a flour-food showdown with 《HARISEN Chop》. What were you thinking?

Is it true you've got a machine gun rigged up in your ride,
ready to unleash hell in a shootout if things go south?

...
Right, of course those are just baseless rumors.

Seems like the rumors have grown some extra tails...
But meeting you here must be fate.
Let me interview you... Show me who you really are.

Walking through the parking area, you spotted the machine of the 【RUMORED WRITER】 you just battled.
A question suddenly came to mind:
What was that suspicious smoke screen that appeared during the battle?

Was it a trap set by 【RUMORED WRITER】?
Curiosity piqued, you approached the machine for a closer look—
and at that moment, a voice suddenly called out from behind.

I don't let anyone touch my machine.
Sorry about that.

That battle was fun.
I couldn't help but use one of my secret "seven tools"...
It'd be problematic if the Japanese authorities found out about me.

If you let this slide, I'll handle the rumors about you.
Most are harmless, but some are spreading malicious lies.
You've become too famous.

Leave it to me.
People might look at you strangely for a while,
but eventually they'll get bored and forget all about it.

Who exactly was she?
Though curious to ask more,
you decided to accept her terms.

But be careful...
Someone might be using your name to commit crimes...

In the deserted parking area, a girl stood alone by her machine,
head down and looking lost in thought.
Occasionally she lifted her head, scanning the area and listening intently to the night sounds.

A deafening exhaust roar tore through the quiet night, echoing across the parking area.
An intruder suddenly appeared, aggressively pulling up beside the girl's machine.

Yo, waiting for someone?
Too bad,
【{bad_name}】 ain't coming.
What...?

And tonight's your last night on the Shuto Expressway.
Nothing personal, kid. You just made too much noise.

For 《CLUB GARUDA》 to seize control...
You gotta disappear.

...
I accept your challenge.

Taking a breather at the parking area, an eye-catching machine crossed your path—
an NSX.

when faced with it, your body doesn't cooperate...

What's the color of your machine, big brother?
Oh? I see... that's funnyyyy.

When I wear these goggles, my concentration goes up.
Don't you have a switch like that too?

The gender of chicks is determined by looking at their rear ends, which is very difficult.
Before I knew it, I started imagining whether cars were male or female.
Looking at the tail of your car... it's more like a female.

As I kept running diligently here, I became a little famous,
and somehow ended up with a nickname.
But... don't you think 【MOUNTAIN MAN】 isn't quite right?

Sports athletes have limited time to shine at the top.
The issue is the second life after retirement.
Lately, I've been talking about this with 【SWIMMER YUTO】.

..........
Do you need something from me?

When the body paint on a machine looks cool, it gets me excited.
I'm aiming for an awesome paint job that no one can imitate!

The fun in battles is the strategy.
I don't enjoy winning just by straight-line speed due to machine performance.

Huh?
You're wondering why we 《Phantom9》 don't act like a proper team despite being one?
Hahahahaha! You really know how to hit where it hurts!

Since you're pure enough to ask such an innocent question, let me enlighten you.
《Phantom9》 is an elite group handpicked by 【SNAKE EYES】... The previous one, that is.
Point being, we didn't come together to be best buddies.

The only thing expected of us was results.
And... We delivered, didn't we?
If you want to crush teams, the best way is to paint over them with an even stronger team's name.

Well, both four years ago and this time around,
we got some interference that kinda ruined our perfect finish.

Everyone keeps calling me "dirty," but like,
I'm really not that bad, am I?
Geez, just because they lost to me doesn't mean they should make up stories!

...So, which one are you?
My ally? Or my enemy?

That guy 【DYING STAR】 is a bit neurotic.
Just enjoy the battle without feeling pressured.
You should also take it easy.

Someday I'll be part of the team too.
Right now, I'm just looking for someone suitable to be the team leader.

【ETERNAL POLARIS】 is such a sweet, honest girl.
She actually listened seriously when I talked about my "love troubles."
...Usually people don't take me seriously when I bring it up, you know?

When I told her about how I met my "destined lady"...
Her eyes lit up with this strange excitement.
Well, she's at that age, so I guess it's natural for a girl to be interested in that kind of thing.

I'm tired of being used by the government.
How long do we have to keep doing this...

"Know your enemy and know yourself, and you'll never lose a hundred battles."
The key to victory is taking your time to study your opponent.
I'm looking forward to showing MASTER 【STEEL HEART】 my new driving style.

What the hell happened to Daigo while I was away from
the Shuto Expressway with 【STEEL HEART】?
His obsession with India before was already over the top, but this...

Sorry, I'm in a hurry.
I have to wash all the team members' machines.

... It was out of my control.
It was just a minor mistake that made my driving weird, I didn't do it on purpose...

My boyfriend said, "You've always ridden in my car, so why? No way..."
He's silly... I just wanted my own machine.
I never thought of breaking up with him.

Don't talk to me... If a man is kind to me now, I might fall in love again.
And if that happens, can you take responsibility?

I worry about 【TRAGIC RED TEARS】's love life,
but he doesn't notice my feelings at all...

As a surgeon, I often see patients who were in traffic accidents.
Because we are street racers, we need to be more aware of driving safely in our everyday lives.

You think a doctor needs muscles like this?
Haha... there's a certain manga that inspired me to pursue medicine.
In that story, muscles were essential for doctors!

I'm in charge of security at the general hospital... but there are no ghosts.
It seems the superstition I believed in was just my imagination, and I might not have any
connection to the occult.

I've been telling 【REVENGEFUL WHITE KNIGHT】 from 《COOL ENERGY》
to quit street racing and take a rest, but he won't listen!
Maybe I'll have to crush him and break his spirit?

【PAIN TRAIN】 was advising 【REVENGEFUL WHITE KNIGHT】 to retire again.
Well, health comes first.
But saying it too much can backfire on stubborn patients...

【THUNDER EAGLE】 from 《The Pleiades》 is seriously working as a weather forecaster.
I've become a "dirty" talent.
I worked hard to get my certification, so how did it end up like this...

Tire pressure, check! Side mirrors, check! Oil temperature, check!
Hmm? Do you find my actions strange?
Pointing and confirming is essential before starting to run.

I've got some good parts, interested? ...No?
It seems 【SPIKE MOON】 has been selling poor quality parts, so people are more cautious now.
But my parts are really recommended.

Man, I really can't thank 【SILVER FOX】 enough.
Thanks to him, our restaurant is so busy, it's a delightful struggle... oh, a call.

"Hello? What? A reservation for a group of 11?
And they want to confirm if they can wear their football protectors?"
...That's them, right?

It's self-praise, but I think we created a pretty amazing team with 《Be Legend》.
When we formed, we were called a "street racer rehabilitation factory"... but they were 
originally renowned warriors. Many of them are not just "reborn," they're reaching new peaks.

You recently started racing too, right?
Is that your machine?
Hmm... is the engine still stock? What about a supercharger? Any pillow ball joints?

Oh, sorry for bombarding you with questions.
Collecting data is my hobby, so I'm interested in new street racers.
Anyway, do you change the tire pressure between the front and rear?

I came from Hokkaido after a long time,
but it's still hot here... I need to buy some clothes.

...That time, the in-car camera was out of position...
I was distracted by it...
That loss was inevitable...

【WANDERING MONSTER】 is a partner I've been racing with for a long time.
When I think about how he goes home to his wife...
It's kind of amazing...

I've known 【KILLING MACHINE】 for a long time.
We often race together or tune each other's machines.
He's like a trusted buddy.

I got married last year,
and now 【KILLING MACHINE】 sometimes uses polite language with me, saying "You're amazing."
He seems to feel awkward around married people.

Do you have a rival you're aiming for?
While I want to catch up to him, I also want him to stay strong forever.
It's a complicated feeling.

Okay... "Everyone, see you at the Hakozaki Parking Area at 23:00 next week"... and sent.
Sigh, why did I end up being the team's schedule manager and contact person...?

Hey, are you racing energetically?
Well, I'm more energetic than you! Hahaha!

Leading a group is tough, isn't it?
I'm often consulted by our leader, 【KILLING MACHINE】...
It seems pretty hard, doesn't it?

Still, he's doing well.
I'm a lone wolf by nature, so I couldn't do that.

I got scolded with "How can you sleep during a meeting?"
But the meetings are too long.
People ask questions they don't need to here, and it makes me sleepy, right?

It's a misconception that drifting is hard with a 4WD.
If you don't believe me...
I'll show you next time we meet on the course.

Hey, I haven't seen that girl over there before.
Hmm, she's pretty cute.
I'm gonna go talk to her.

Mr. 【LEMON FLAVOR】 used to be more serious about racing,
but now he's always chasing girls, and his machine has turned into a date car.
I'll keep pursuing racing on my own.

Hey! Machines are all about power!
That kind of power that just breaks through with a BOOM is irresistible, right!

Ah, why are company meetings so long...
Those people who ask questions like, "Do we really need to discuss this here?" 
make no sense at all. Ah... it really gets to me.

When I ask the guys I race with, "How's my driving?"
they always say, "That aero is awesome."
I'm happy they compliment my custom aero, but... well... sigh.

Ah, crap... I heard something I didn't need to know...
Oh, well, our leader seems to have been dumped by his girlfriend.
Yeah, I need to pretend I didn't hear anything... such a hassle...

When people hear I'm a CEO and a racer, they say it's "cool."
But people don't really understand; it's actually a lot of stress.

Life has its ups and downs.
I once left the team, but
after going around and around, I ended up back here.

Suspension is important for a machine.
I focus on ensuring traction is firmly transmitted to the road.
So I recommend properly setting up the suspension and dampers.

Well, I've got a kid now, so I try to help with the housework.
But after working on my machine, when I try to do house chores,
my wife gets mad... says my hands are dirty with oil.

It's strange... I run perfectly in my mind...
Is it that I can't move as I imagine? ???
No, maybe I've misjudged my own level?

Damn, I can't calm down.
...What are you looking at?
Don't look at me like that!

I know our team is looked down upon.
But there are many who can't be left alone.
We need to look out for those who join us.

...Guh.
I can't eat anymore...

Now, it's now or never for me.
I can't afford to race with regrets.
On this Shuto Expressway-I will give it my all.

Machines that make a loud noise are honestly annoying.
Everyone should listen to the pleasant sound of a naturally aspirated engine.

When you tune your machine, you often "reduce weight," right?
It's not just the machine, the driver should also reduce weight.
I know that... I understand it...
I've heard rumors about you. You seem to know a lot of people.

How do you make friends so easily?
I've been coming here for a while, but I haven't made any friends...

The emotions that arise in the heart and the recognition in the head are different things.
I didn't know realizing your own feelings could come with such a surprise.

I can't believe it...
I was so interested in that man.

Huh, this isn't like me.
Maybe the "me" I recognize is different from the real "me"?

Ah...
Um...
Well...
If you're going to be our enemy, I won't show any mercy.

That said, you're someone our boss has taken an interest in.
If you want to join us, we'll welcome you with open arms.

Everyone wants their business to run smoothly, right?
What's essential for that is, first, accurate information.
And then analysis.

So...
I've gathered information about you down to the finest detail...
Investigated you thoroughly, inside and out...

Hey, you're dressed quite fashionably, impressive.
Let me tell you the upcoming trends... let's see, earth tones and mermaid skirts.
Huh? I'm not talking about car side skirts.

Having to travel to headquarters is a pain, but getting to tear through here after work makes it all worthwhile.
Pointless meetings, performance reviews that are all for show, rules that exist just to exist...
When I'm out here racing, all that frustration just... Melts away.

"The Butterfly Effect"--
It begins as nothing more than a tiny force.

Like the "wind" created by a butterfly's wings...
They say even the slightest disturbance can eventually bring about great chaos.
It's a parable about how the future is impossible to predict.
You... might just be that "wind."

Hey, your machine makes a nice sound.
I design engines for work, so I'm quite knowledgeable about that.
If you have trouble with engine maintenance, feel free to consult me.

...Come to think of it, it's been ages since I started racing these highways.
Been a long while since I got myself a brand new machine too.

...I'm looking forward to it, you know.
Seeing just how far that guy can go...

Have you battled 【PURSUING TAILGUNNER】 yet?
...Why? I just wanted to hear a third party's opinion about his driving.
Though I don't need to ask if he's slower than me, right?

H-Hey there... I'd like to hear your opinion too...
These sunglasses, are they la—... how do they look?
P-Please, give me your honest thoughts...

Have you already battled with 【SHADOW EYES】?
Well, it's nothing special...
I just wanted to know how their driving was.

Eeheeheehee... Who would've thought the Four Heavenly Kings of the THIRTEEN DEVILS would reunite?
Though honestly... 【PURSUING TAILGUNNER】 and 【SHADOW EYES】
probably just found a convenient excuse to team up again.

As for the original Four Heavenly Kings, THE 4 DEVAS...
【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】 might be willing, but
【MIDNIGHT SILVER WOLF】 says he won't race with anyone anymore, so it's hopeless.

And the last one...
We don't even know if they're still alive...

"Hello... How's the progress on the city circuit acquisition?
What? It's not going well?!"

"...In that case, perhaps we should crush《GNK Racing》directly
and break 【RETURN OF ZORRO】's spirit..."

Eh, eh-heh-heh, heh-heh-heh...
【ROULETTE GUY NO. 1】 and 【ROULETTE GUY NO. 2】 messed with my machine all over,
and now it feels like a completely different beast...

The speed is insane!
I don't care who I'm up against, I can't lose now!
I've obtained the ultimate power! Yeehaw!

Racing on the Shuto Expressway, I've noticed there are quite a few people in the same business.
I run a hobby shop that specializes in models.
I've actually met 【ROULETTE GUY NO. 5】 at hobby-related events before.

My sister takes her obsessions way too far...
Just because she likes car models doesn't mean she had to become an actual street racer.
W-Well, I don't exactly hate it when she invites me along...

...Hmph.
Sorry, but I won't let anyone drive ahead of me.
Absolutely, absolutely, absolutely not...

How's that? When I got scouted by 《Phantom9》,
I figured this would be my character.
Gimmicks are important, you know!

Don't you think obsession is like gravity?
Once you throw yourself into it, it gives you boundless power.

But it's an uncontrollable power.
Once you take off, you can't stop yourself.
And the end is always tragic.

... Even so, there are heights you can't reach without this power,
heights you must reach.

Both 【BLACK DRAGON】 and 【LIGHT TIGER】 are possessed by that man.
They've both changed a lot.

When I think about their feelings, I can't stop them...
But I have a bad feeling about this.

Driving and tuning are truly profound.
I will continue to work hard to support the team and the leader who warmly welcomed me.

Do you have a street racer you admire?
The power born from admiration is amazing!
It takes you to places you could never reach alone.

The leaders have been obsessed with 【SNAKE EYES】 for years,
but if they defeat him, where will they go next?

Lately, 【LADY WHITE】 has been a bit harsh on me.
I thought the team had finally become united again, 
but I really hope we can avoid more trouble...

Brother... the Shuto Expressway I visited to find you,
might have opened a new life for me.

I got spurred on by 【LADY WHITE】.
I hope things go well naturally with him...
But five years is a long time to wait.

I love thrill rides, but how about you?
It's a different kind of excitement from controlling high-speed driving yourself.

I'm good at and can take right corners quickly,
but I'm really bad and slow at left corners.
I sometimes wonder if it's because I'm not left-handed.

He's just so incredibly dense, it's really annoying!
How long does that 【FULL MOON MADNESS】 guy plan to ignore 【PEARL WHITE KISS】's feelings!
Watching from the sidelines frustrates me more than it does her!

Seriously, what's with him... Dense! Insensitive! Thick-headed! Frozen banana!
What's with 【FULL MOON MADNESS】! To 【PEARL WHITE KISS】, it's just a "waste of years"!
Sigh... Don't become a guy who doesn't understand a woman's heart.

How did they find out I do hero shows...?
The other day, the 《MACHINE RANGERS》 surrounded me and asked for my autograph.
But I don't even have an autograph...

Seriously... why does that stupid manager always give me work right before it's time to leave?!
If it's really necessary by the end of the day, tell me in the morning! It drives me mad!
Huh? Oh, I'm not talking to you, just leave me be.

You have to do things step by step, diligently.
I couldn't keep up with my buddies' driving before, but I learned techniques one by one,
and recently, I've finally been able to drive like everyone else.

Oh man, Japanese machines and the Shuto Expressway are just amazing!
You know, I've always really admired Japanese cars since I was young.
This NC1 Type S in particular is absolutely perfect!

And the battles here are thrilling and fantastic!
Well, I lost to 【FOREIGN PRINCESS】 and 【SHY MAID】...
But just being here in Japan fills my heart with joy... no, it overflows!

Oh, my brother is such a romantic.
No matter how beautifully he designs a cornering machine, here on the bayshore line,
it can't beat my machine set up for top speed.

Um... good evening...
My team consists of... Masters from a certain royal family... I mean, wealthy household,
and... Servants like myself.

When we're racing, we're told to drive our hardest regardless of social status...
Um... 【FOREIGN PRINCE】 is our master, but
I always overtake him, yes.

A childhood friend I played with like a brother turned out to be a prince of a certain country.
He's a good guy and says, "Treat me the same as before," but...
Yeah, that's just impossible.

Do you need something from me?
Sorry, not many people talk to me by choice.

...Ah, I see.
You're the one she was talking about...
Interesting, indeed.

Did you know that if you make the screen door mesh "black," the mesh becomes invisible, and you 
can see outside clearly? We changed to the black type recently, and the cat thought there was 
no mesh and bumped into it. Oh, if you're replacing aluminum sashes, feel free to consult me.

From a little traffic jam, the cars gradually decrease,
and when the road is all clear ahead, the acceleration when you open the throttle!
It's like releasing everything you've held back all at once, that moment is irresistible.

Oh, I haven't made the test for the next lecture yet.
Maybe I'll just change the date and use last year's...
I heard the students have noticed.

Yes! Let's return to classic development here!
Thinking of names while driving sharpens my mind the most.

Hey, you there.
I can see people's "auras,"
and you... you have quite a mysterious aura around you.

A great calamity will befall this Shuto Expressway... such a sinister aura, oh, oh.
Ahem... if you want to know more, you'll have to pay.
Whether you believe it or not is up to you.

Hey, I'm a professional courier.
If it's something normal couriers can't handle... something a bit dangerous, I can deliver it.
Keep that in mind.

Excuse me.
You... you aren't the so-called "Legendary Tuner," are you?

...Right, you're not.
Hmm, I've heard that the person called the "Legendary Tuner" sometimes comes to the parking area.
So I really want to meet them... that's why I'm searching like this.

I don't like racing just to play nice.
Some guys are still hung up on old names like "THIRTEEN DEVILS" and whatnot...
But we never teamed up to be best buddies in the first place.

I'm thinking of making an original picture book for the kids' bedtime stories.
It's called "The 13 Happy Racers"... But maybe that's too many characters?

...What about the illustrations?
Well, I know I'm no artist compared to 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】,
but the kids seem to like my unique style, so I'll manage somehow.
Those little brats... They're young, so they don't hold back with their brutally honest critiques...

My business is sometimes called "outrageously expensive," but
whether you feel it's worth paying that amount is up to the customer.
It's the same when you buy a machine, right?

Instead of spending all your money on cars,
why don't you give your girlfriend a bouquet of roses for a change?
I bet she'd love it!!

What?!
You don't have a girlfriend?!
Then let's go for a drive and find you one!!

《CHANGING STAGE》, huh.
I also work as a car magazine reporter, and they're strong rivals.

Oh, not the magazine, the team.
They are the creators of the magazine also named 《CHANGING STAGE》.

They don't just observe; they achieve high-level driving themselves,
which gives their articles incredible credibility.

Huh? Me?
No... I don't own a car...

Plenty of street racers are music lovers, and there's tons of folks from the music biz too.
Nothing beats cruising to your favorite tunes.

《ROAD CONCERTO》 is one of those crews.
Every single member's connected to the classical music world,
and some of 'em are world-renowned, first-class players.

Battles are great and all, but I hope they're careful
not to get hurt in a way that'd mess with their performances.

《FAMILY BUSINESS》 is a unique team.
They say the members are all family.

The first leader, the grandfather, has retired,
but it seems he's still keeping an eye on things.

The current leader, 【GREATEST PAPA】, has his son-in-law as a member,
so he has to be careful in all directions.

If it were me, I'd get an ulcer...
Even now, I'm hiding from my demon wife to be here -- Oh, a call!
"Hello, I'm at work! Working hard!"

You're a street racer too?
Then, can you introduce me to someone from the team 《COOL ENERGY》?

Those people are IT company presidents and executives,
a group of high-spec men.

What? Their machines are high-spec too? That's not what I'm talking about.
I wonder if I could get to know them somehow...

I'm a regular at the tuning shop "Akihara Speed Factory,"
and the people there take care of me.
I'm definitely supporting 《A.S.F.》.

After all, 【SPRING MEMORY】, who was overseas, has come back.
That guy is usually spaced out, but suddenly takes bold actions.

I never expected he'd come back as a professional racer.
The president and leader, 【BOSS OF NEW CIRCULAR ROUTE】, didn't show it on his face,
but he was really happy.

《NAYUTA》 is a highly excellent team.
They take pride in "data battles" based on calculated numbers, not just intuition.

Additionally, each team member must have a machine with a unique feature that no
other member has.
Given my humanities background, it's obvious why I can't join as a member.

Do you know the team 《RINGS》?
They've maintained top-class skills on the Shuto Expressway for years,
they're an awesome team.

I used to drive an RX-7,
and I wanted to join this team, so I approached them.
They told me to beat all the members to join... so I ran away.

Beating those members is impossible, right?
Can I save midway? Heal my HP? ... I'm just saying.
I think running away that time was my fastest speed ever.

Historical teams are different in class.
So, I gave up on the machine,
and now I'm having fun with rhythm and beats.

The wind feels nice in this parking area, doesn't it?
I like it here.
Do you come here often?

The other day, while enjoying the breeze here, a man approached me.
He told me he's a street racer from the team 《Aquarium》.

Hehe... it was funny.
The team 《Aquarium》 is apparently made up of only single members,
and there's a strict rule that they must leave the team if they get married.

He invited me on a date, but I politely declined.
It would be sad if he had to leave the team just because of that.

【SALTY DOG】 is a sports instructor,
and he also teaches me strength training.
The other day, I met the members of 《TOKIO JUNGLE》 at the sports club.

Apparently, they started going there because they became concerned about their physique after
turning 30,
and to maintain sharp driving skills.

I like cars too, so I talked to them a bit.
Their team prohibits drifting and focuses on grip driving.
I was really impressed.

Also, since they all live near Tokyo,
it's easy for them to gather,
and they have interactions outside of racing, which is an enviable friendship.

《KNIFE AND FORKS》 you say?
I'm glad you asked me!

That team consists of people working at the French restaurant "La Liberté."
The leader, 【INVINCIBLE FULL COURSE】, is the owner,
and the taste is just exquisite!

I'm a regular there!
Ah, I'm getting hungry...
I think I'll go eat there again...

It's true that 《HARISEN Chop》 has come to the Shuto Expressway.
They used to run on the Hanshin Expressway back home.

They were said to be a really strong team.
...But I wonder what happened to their jobs and homes.

I'm from Tokyo, so it's fine for me...
Huh? This way of speaking? I learned it from TV!

《TOP LEVEL》 is great...
Two guys and four women.
How much virtue did the leader, 【TARMAC SUZUKI】, accumulate in his previous life?

They're a MITSUBISHI-based team, so they don't get along with the SUBARU-based
《ANOTHER STAR》.
But I find myself wanting to support 《ANOTHER STAR》...

Have you raced 《UNLIMITED》 yet?
Their team used to be called the "Bayshore's Strongest."

With all the new crews popping up, I can't say if that title still holds true...
But their passion burns hot, and they never lose that aggressive edge.
Led by 【KILLING MACHINE】, they've got serious skills.

And in their pure pursuit of racing,
they show no mercy to those shameless punks who'd tarnish a racer's name...
In a way, I didn't hate their childish sense of justice.

I've already stepped away from it all...
But I hope those guys keep shining
just as bright as they always have.

The Shuto Expressway is amazing...
I'm here to support 《2Limit》.
I wonder if the teachers are also racing.

《2Limit》 is a team formed by people from "Hanemura General Hospital."
They really took care of my son when he was seriously ill.

My son is a fan too.
"When I grow up, I want to become a street racer and join the team,"
he says.

Have you seen multiple GT-Rs roaring into the parking area?
Yeah... it's intimidating.
That's probably the guys from 《Free Way》.

In addition to their superior machine performance, their technique is also top-notch.
They're unbeatable in top-speed battles on the New Circular Route.

If you plan to challenge them,
choose a place with as many corners as possible.

《Neo Limited》 was formed to rival 《UNLIMITED》,
who used to be feared as the "Bayshore's Strongest."
Though lately, it seems like both teams are getting pushed around by the new blood.

Ever since 《UNLIMITED》 started slipping,
《Neo Limited》's leader, 【LEMON FLAVOR】,
lost his drive. Word is he's more into chasing skirts than racing these days.

Maybe it's that complicated male pride thing—
wanting your rival to stay at the top.

Hehe... those guys.
《Be Legend》 is laughable.

It looks like they've changed their name, but it doesn't work.
Their obsession, their aura... and that driving.
Those who know the past can't be fooled.

Don't mess with them recklessly.
Hehe...

I got passed by a ridiculously fast GR86,
and I heard that it was a member of 《GNK Racing》.

GNK is the company that runs the Shuto Expressway circuit, right?
Their employees and professional racers formed the team.

They're aiming to participate in a one-make race for GR86 and BRZ,
honing their skills.

Yeah, it's scary.
What's scary? 《CLUB GARUDA》 is.

Their driving is rough, and all the members have a scary vibe.
Especially the leader, 【THUNDER ROAD】, why is he always so edgy?

Young people have their issues, but
I feel a dangerous vibe, like they're going to destroy themselves.

《HASEGAWA'S ANGELS》 is a team formed by three sisters who run a hobby shop.
I go to their place pretty often, actually.
Quite a few racers on the Shuto Expressway are regulars there too.

I can't help buying models of the same car I drive.
I've lost count of how many identical models I've bought...
Well, I'd chat with them about the Shuto Expressway and show them photos I took at the Parking Area.

Turns out that got them fired up to actually hit the road themselves.
And just like that, they joined the ranks of the racers.
Though I gotta say, I'm a bit worried about their choice of "favorites"... quite the troublesome bunch.

【INDOMITABLE ALEXANDER】 is a monster of endurance who drove 3,000 km non-stop, except for refueling.

Haha, there's no one more straightforward than that!

You challenged 【STRONGEST MAAMIN】 to a battle but got ignored?

Want to battle 【GENTLE EXAMINER】?
Do you also like cute things?

He doesn't battle with cars of any other drive type.

Well, he works delivering supplies to mountain huts.
There must be more climbers on weekends.

【FLYING FISH OF SHUTO EXPRESSWAY】?
